records.pipeline_name: Great Basin Gas Transmission Company Pipeline System

verifications.note: A Nevada Current article from June 2026 quotes a letter filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission by Great Basin Gas Transmission saying the expansion will support future economic development, including data centers, and describes a 14-mile run to the Tahoe Regional Industrial Center.

records.researcher_notes: A Nevada Current article from June 2026 quotes the Great Basin filing at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, which says the expansion will support existing customers and future economic development including data centers. The new line ends at the Tahoe Regional Industrial Center in Storey County. No named data center customer was found.

verifications.note: A Boardwalk press release on the final investment decision for the Kosci Junction Project quotes its chief executive saying the project supplies gas needed to support the growth of data centers and industrial demand.

records.researcher_notes: A Boardwalk press release from December 2024 quotes its chief executive saying the Kosci Junction Project supports the growth of data centers and industrial demand. No named data center customer was found.
